rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP and accessed two orders, but it performed order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation. It changed the shipping address on order #W6750959 and swapped an item using modify_pending_order_items, and even altered the payment method to PayPal—none of which were confirmed by the user beforehand. There is also no clear evidence that the replacement item was the cheapest green Bluetooth speaker (no pricing/variant comparison shown), and the final message does not provide a confirmation or summary of changes. These violate the policy requirements to confirm before writes and to provide correct final information. While the agent did act on the user’s orders and used the other order’s NYC address as requested, the unconfirmed writes and unsupported product selection make the outcome fail the pass bar.
